legacyOptions.expr: count_values("generation", nixos_system_generation{job="nixos-exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and (nixos_system_switch_timestamp_seconds{job="nixos-exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > last_over_time(nixos_system_switch_timestamp_seconds{job="nixos-exporter", instance=~"$instance"}[1d] offset $__interval)) unless (nixos_boots_total{job="nixos-exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > last_over_time(nixos_boots_total{job="nixos-exporter", instance=~"$instance"}[1d] offset $__interval)))

spec.description: Continuous profiling: Alloy eBPF -> Pyroscope. Flame graphs + per-unit CPU, and pipeline health.

Merged on-CPU stacks (49 Hz eBPF sampling) of the selected unit over the time range; width = CPU time. `[unknown]` = unsymbolized frames, `other` = nodes merged by the 16384 node limit (large for All).
spec.title: On-CPU flame graph ($service_name)

spec.description: Merged off-CPU stacks of the selected unit: time blocked/sleeping (I/O, locks, waits), sampled (blocks >= 20ms threshold scaled). Width = blocked time, summed over threads. `other` = nodes merged by the 16384 node limit.
spec.title: Off-CPU flame graph ($service_name)

spec.description: Disk usage of /var/lib/pyroscope (du every 15m). PyroscopeDiskHigh fires above 50 GB.
spec.title: Pyroscope disk

spec.description: Profiles dropped by Alloy (eBPF + write queue) over the range. ProfilesDropped alerts on > 0 in 5m for 15m.
spec.title: Profiles dropped

spec.description: Processes the eBPF profiler currently tracks (discovery targets).
spec.title: eBPF targets

spec.description: Alloy components not healthy (AlloyUnhealthy alert > 0 for 10m), ex: the eBPF profiler failed to load.
spec.title: Unhealthy components

spec.description: Alloy scrape status.
spec.title: Alloy

spec.description: Pyroscope scrape status.
spec.title: Pyroscope

spec.description: Profiled on-CPU time of the selected unit by executable, in cores (CPU s/s), top 10; stacked. Gaps = no samples (idle).
spec.title: CPU by exe ($service_name)

spec.description: Profiled on-CPU time per systemd unit, in cores (CPU s/s), whole host, top 10; stacked. Gaps = no samples (idle). Click a series to open that unit in Profiles Drilldown.
spec.title: CPU by unit (top 10)

spec.description: Disk usage of /var/lib/pyroscope (du every 15m). Dashed red line = PyroscopeDiskHigh threshold (50 GB), visible once usage nears it.
spec.title: Pyroscope disk

spec.description: Dropped profiles (eBPF, write queue), failing eBPF sessions, and Pyroscope rejected pushes, per second. Should be flat 0.
spec.title: Drops + failures

spec.description: Sample values written by Pyroscope's segment writer, by profile type.
spec.title: Ingested samples/s

spec.description: CPU of the Alloy and Pyroscope processes; 100% = one core.
spec.title: Process CPU

spec.description: Resident memory of the Alloy and Pyroscope processes.
spec.title: Process RSS

spec.description: Compressed bytes Alloy sent vs. bytes Pyroscope received, by profile type (compressed + decompressed).
spec.title: Ingest bytes/s

spec.description: pyroscope.write push latency to the endpoint, p50/p99.
spec.title: Push latency

spec.description: Profiles collected by eBPF, sent by pyroscope.write, and received by the Pyroscope distributor. All three should match.
spec.title: Profiles/s

spec.description: Stack samples per second in eBPF profiles (CPU + off-CPU), top 10 units. On-CPU: 49 Hz per busy core.
spec.title: eBPF samples/s by unit (top 10)
